     assert isinstance( w.sip, wcs.Sip )
     assert w.sip.crpix[0] == 2048
     assert w.sip.crpix[1] == 1026
+
+
+def test_zero_size_input():
+    """
+    Test that empty arrays are handled correctly in WCS transformations.
+    Regression test for issue where empty arrays would cause an error.
+    """
+    w = wcs.WCS(naxis=2)
+    w.wcs.crpix = [1, 1]
+    w.wcs.crval = [0, 0]
+    w.wcs.cdelt = [1, 1]
+    
+    # Test wcs_pix2world with empty arrays (list of arrays)
+    result = w.wcs_pix2world([], [], 0)
+    assert len(result) == 2
+    assert result[0].shape == (0,)
+    assert result[1].shape == (0,)
+    
+    # Test wcs_pix2world with empty single array
+    result = w.wcs_pix2world(np.array([]).reshape(0, 2), 0)
+    assert result.shape == (0, 2)
+    
+    # Test all_pix2world with empty arrays
+    result = w.all_pix2world([], [], 0)
+    assert len(result) == 2
+    assert result[0].shape == (0,)
+    assert result[1].shape == (0,)
+    
+    # Test wcs_world2pix with empty arrays
+    result = w.wcs_world2pix([], [], 0)
+    assert len(result) == 2
+    assert result[0].shape == (0,)
+    assert result[1].shape == (0,)
